steps.text: The game data must come from your own PS1 NTSC copy of wipEout. On the PC, prepare a wipeout folder as the README of github.com/SgtBilko76/Wipeout-Rewrite-VR describes. Put it into a checkout of that repository and, with the headset connected, run android/push_data.sh before the first start. Then open Wipeout Rewrite VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The APK is ready, but the game data is prepared by hand and pushed with the repository's android/push_data.sh; the guide does not say where the script puts the data, so qgp cannot push it yet. Read push_data.sh to turn this into a push step. Optional music goes in wipeout/music/trackNN.qoa. Releases are all pre-releases and also carry a Pico APK, which the asset pattern does not match.
